description: There have been a total of 24 prime ministers in Canada's history, but before Monday night only 13 could claim to have led their party to a majority of seats in the House of Commons. Mark Carney is now the 14th to do it.
title: Mark Carney enters his majority era

description: Kiki Rice is the Toronto Tempo's first-ever WNBA draft pick. The Tempo selected the UCLA guard sixth overall in the first round Monday, 10 days after adding its first players in the WNBA expansion draft.
title: Toronto Tempo select UCLA guard Kiki Rice with first-ever WNBA draft pick

description: The U.S. military has initiated a blockade across the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea, a move experts say is an act of war with potential for serious escalation in the midst of a ceasefire. U.S. Central Command says it is targeting all vessels traveling to and from Iran as of Monday morning
title: How will the U.S. blockade of Iranian ports work, and what will it achieve?

description: The CEO of Hootsuite has stepped down after spending the last several months defending a contract between the company and a controversial U.S. government department, making way for the firm's founder to return on an interim basis.
title: Hootsuite founder Ryan Holmes returns to CEO role on interim basis, as Irina Novoselsky exits

description: For Michael Ignatieff, news that Viktor Orbán’s 16-year rule in Hungary had come to an end was reason enough to raise a glass. He speaks about what Orbán’s defeat and Péter Magyar's victory could mean for geopolitics.
title: Orbán’s defeat may signal shift in Europe’s far-right, illiberal tide says Michael Ignatieff

description: The RCMP conducted a four-year undercover investigation aimed at getting Dean Penney to open up about his estranged wife's disappearance. He moved weapons, diamonds, and even participated in a fuel heist at the U.S. border. It was all fake.
title: Guns, jewels and a heist: Inside the fake world police built for accused killer Dean Penney

description: Statistics Canada says the income gap — measuring the difference in the share of disposable income between households in the top 40 per cent and those in the bottom 40 per cent — reached 46.7 percentage points in 2025.
title: Gap between richest and poorest Canadians widened again in 2025, StatsCan says

description: The investigation, announced on the attorney general's website Monday, concerns whether Lululemon's athletic apparel contains PFAS, or perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.
title: Texas attorney general launches investigation into Lululemon's potential use of certain chemicals

description: Australian actress Ruby Rose alleged in a post on social media that American singer Katy Perry sexually assaulted her at a night club 20 years ago, a claim the pop star's representatives deny. The allegation first came in response to a Complex post on Instagram about Perry’s reaction to singer Justin Bieber’s headlining Coachella set.
title: Ruby Rose accuses Katy Perry of sexual assault, which singer denies

description: Bill 29, if passed, would allow Albertans to self-refer to private clinics across the province, later this year.
title: Alberta moves to allow private diagnostic tests without a doctor’s referral

description: A Minnesota county is investigating the arrest of a Hmong American man by federal officers that was captured on video as a potential case of kidnapping, burglary and false imprisonment, officials announced Monday.
title: Minnesota authorities probe ICE arrest of St. Paul man as possible kidnapping

description: More than a thousand movie stars, writers, directors and other Hollywood professionals announced their "unequivocal opposition" to the proposed Paramount merger with Warner Bros. Discovery in an open letter published Monday.
title: Hollywood stars express opposition to Paramount-Warner merger in open letter

description: A 16-year-old boy has been charged with murder and aggravated sexual abuse in Florida in the death of his 18-year-old stepsister on a Carnival Cruise Line ship, the U.S. Justice Department said Monday.
title: Florida teen charged with aggravated sexual abuse, murder of stepsister on cruise ship

description: The Trump administration said Monday it will resume flying a rainbow Pride flag on a federal flagpole at the Stonewall National Monument in New York City, reversing course after removing the banner in February.
title: Trump administration reverses ban on flying Pride flag at Stonewall monument

description: It wasn't until he was in his 20s that Rob Berkowits learned his father was in one of the most famous photos of a concentration camp in the Second World War.
title: Winnipegger honours dad who was among survivors shown in famous concentration camp photo

description: People in Central Newfoundland are trying to make sense of a stunning cascade of tragedies and deadly shootings in recent days. And it’s again raising questions about how to address the systemic problem of violence against women.
title: 2 central N.L. shootings in 2 days reignite calls for more resources to protect vulnerable women, children

description: A string of box office successes is, perhaps surprisingly, supported by what seemed a fading remnant of the Hollywood landscape just a few years ago: non-franchises and even the occasional original feature.
title: Super Mario Galaxy, Project Hail Mary help support best box office since start of pandemic

description: A federal judge on Monday dismissed U.S. President Donald Trump’s defamation lawsuit against the Wall Street Journal, a setback for Trump in his legal campaign against media companies he accuses of treating him unfairly.
title: Judge throws out Trump's $10B US lawsuit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein birthday card

description: Critics of Alberta's proposed rule changes to public libraries say the true danger lies in giving the province power to dictate access and potentially snoop on which books people are checking out.
title: Alberta's access restrictions threaten privacy and democratic role of libraries, critics say

description: Mohamad Hassan Haidar split his time between Windsor and Lebanon, where he wanted to ensure his wife, children and horses were safe, a news conference was told Monday in the southwestern Ontario city. Haidar, 38, was killed last week while rushing to a helper on his property during an airstrike in Lebanon, according to his family and the National Council of Canadian Muslims.
title: Windsor, Ont., man killed in strike in Lebanon was rushing to someone shouting for help, family says

description: FIFA recently announced Niagara Falls will be a final stop in an upcoming cross-country tour to celebrate the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
title: Cross-country tour to celebrate FIFA World Cup to wrap with stop in Niagara Falls in July

description: An Israeli airstrike killed at least three Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Monday, health officials said, as mediators met leaders from Hamas in an effort to shore up a U.S.-brokered ceasefire deal.
title: At least 3 killed in Israeli strike on Gaza as talks to advance ceasefire back on

description: Over the weekend, fans flocked to the Californian desert for the Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival for performances by top global artists and emerging acts. Check out some of the scenes from the first weekend.
title: IN PHOTOS | Highlights from Coachella

description: Education Minister Paul Calandra has announced changes to the province's English school systems, including capping the number of elected trustees for boards and creating oversight roles centred on both financial oversight and student achievement.
title: Ontario capping number of school trustees per board, creating new oversight roles

description: The governing body for international swimming and aquatic sports will allow athletes from Russia to compete without restrictions and with their national flag and anthem.
title: Russian swimmers to be allowed to compete with flag and anthem after restrictions dropped

description: Brent crude oil, the international standard, rose $7.04, or 7.4 per cent, to $102.24 US a barrel on Monday. That's up from roughly $70 per barrel before the war in late February. Markets in France, Britain, Germany, Japan, South Korea and more also declined.
title: Oil prices rise, global markets decline ahead of U.S. blockade of Strait of Hormuz
Canada Reads 2026 is about to start

description: Researchers are turning to a new high-tech combination of drones, thermal cameras and artificial intelligence to get a new vantage point on Alberta’s wild boar problem.
title: Alberta testing AI-powered drone technology in battle against wild boar

description: CBC News chief political correspondent Rosemary Barton breaks down the comings and goings since the last federal election that lead to the Liberal Party to be just one seat shy of a majority government. They need just one win in three byelections taking place Monday.
title: Liberals poised to secure majority. How did we get here?

description: Britney Spears has entered a substance abuse treatment facility just over a month after she was arrested on suspicion of driving under t
title: Britney Spears enters treatment facility weeks after DUI arrest

description: Conservation groups say recent calls for the provincial government to legalize the hunting of threatened grizzly bears in Alberta aren't justified by science due to a lack of up-to-date population studies.
title: Conservation groups call for 'science-based' approach to Alberta grizzly bear hunt proposal

description: After a fourth MP crosses the floor, and reported discontent within caucus, Pierre Poilievre’s ability to lead the Conservatives is being called into question. Can he quell the unrest?
title: Can Pierre Poilievre stop the bleeding?

description: A non-profit organization — once in charge of millions of dollars in federal funds — is suing a former employee, alleging she misappropriated more than $6 million to pay for vacations and divert to a Jamaican dance hall singer.
title: Lawsuit accuses Winnipeg woman of taking $6M from non-profit to fund vacations, buy TikTok coins

description: The U.S. military said Sunday that it blew up two boats accused of smuggling drugs in the eastern Pacific Ocean, killing a total of five people and leaving one survivor, as the Trump administration pursues its campaign against alleged traffickers in Latin America while preparing a naval blockade of Iranian ports.
title: Strikes on alleged drug boats kill 5, leave 1 survivor in eastern Pacific, U.S. military says

description: Stephen MacMillan has been in a dispute with his home insurer since 2022's post-tropical storm Fiona. Mould and water damage meant he spent this past winter living in a trailer on the property. MacMillan is not alone in having an unresolved Fiona claim, says the public adjuster representing him.
title: It's been 3½ years since Fiona, but N.S. man still fighting insurer to get home fixed

description: Police raids of Indigenous-owned cannabis stores in Nova Scotia have been headline news. But that’s overshadowing other questions: whether band members even want cannabis stores, and if so, who should own and profit from them. That’s what band members are being asked on the Glooscap First Nation.
title: This First Nation's community in N.S. is asking if it wants pot sold on the reserve at all

description: The future of the newsprint mill in Corner Brook is about as murky as the slurry used to make paper. And all that uncertainty is also being felt by the saw milling sector.
title: As the N.L. newsprint industry sputters, these sawmill owners are framing up a bright future
Cancer remains top cause of death in Canada as new study shows multiple types rising
Shoppers Drug Mart gave her the wrong medication. Months later, she landed in the ER

description: Family and friends of a couple killed last week on a stretch of Highway 69 that's seen other fatal crashes are questioning why the Ontario government has yet to deliver on a long-promised expansion from two to four lanes. Vinod and Shilpa Patel died in a collision along the only remaining two-lane stretch of the highway, near Britt.
title: Family of Sudbury couple killed in latest Highway 69 crash urges Ontario to honour expansion promise
